python.title: Steam Controller needs Python 3
python.body: Install python3 so the battery daemon can read the controller.

battery_color_mode.description: Use the controller's connection colours, or a custom fill colour.
battery_color_mode.label: Battery fill colour

battery_fill_color.description: Battery fill colour when 'Custom colour' is selected. Low battery still uses the low-battery colour.
battery_fill_color.label: Custom fill colour

battery_fill_opacity.description: Battery fill opacity, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (solid). Applies in both connection and custom colour modes.
battery_fill_opacity.label: Battery fill opacity

battery_low_color.description: Battery fill, percentage, signal meter and warning marker colour when the battery is low.
battery_low_color.label: Low battery colour

controller_body_color.description: Fill colour of the controller drawing's body.
controller_body_color.label: Controller body colour

controller_stroke_width.description: Thickness of the controller outline and trackpad edges (0.5–8).
controller_stroke_width.label: Controller outline thickness

illustration_color.description: Line-art colour for the controller drawing.
illustration_color.label: Controller line colour

input_highlight_color.description: Colour of the pressed buttons, stick positions, trigger pull bars and touchpad points in the live input view. Choose any Noctalia palette role or a custom hex colour.
input_highlight_color.label: Input highlight colour

low_threshold.description: Show the low-battery state and send the notification at or below this percentage.
low_threshold.label: Low battery threshold

muted_text_color.description: Percentage sign, 'via' line, dBm label and inactive signal bars. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.
muted_text_color.label: Secondary text colour

notify_low.description: Send a desktop notification when the battery first drops to the threshold.
notify_low.label: Low battery notification

show_battery_bar.description: Show the vertical battery bar beside the controller. When off, the battery bar is hidden and the controller content is centred.
show_battery_bar.label: Show battery bar

show_live_inputs.description: Overlay live button presses, stick movement, trigger pulls and touchpad points on the controller.
show_live_inputs.label: Live input visualisation

show_percentage.description: Show the battery percentage below the controller.
show_percentage.label: Show battery percentage

show_signal.description: Show the wireless link quality for a controller connected through the puck.
show_signal.label: Show signal strength

show_status.description: Show the connection, charging and low-battery status line below the controller.
show_status.label: Show status text

signal_style.description: Show bars, bars plus dBm, or the dBm value alone.
signal_style.label: Signal display

text_color.description: Percentage, status text and active signal bars. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.
text_color.label: Text colour
